english: Hello. I speak Arabic. I am here about: a Notice to Appear from Executive Office for Immigration Review - Immigration Court. I need help with: a Notice to Appear in immigration court - confirming the hearing date and finding a lawyer. Please speak slowly or write it down. Thank you.
